messages:
Julia G: Heads-up — QuantumBridge (channel partner) asked if we can run a joint POC next week. They want: k8s tenanting (namespaces + quotas), VPC peering, egress bandwidth caps, and an answer to a quick security questionnaire. Also want pricing for a 2-week stress run.
Omar S: Thanks — can you drop the questionnaire PDF? I can start the pricing calc.
Julia G: Uploaded here: https://files.redwood.example/qb-security-qs.pdf
Kai P: @Omar S re infra: we can do namespace isolation + resource quotas. main concerns: disk/ephemeral PVC limits, and KV cache memory usage during large-batch evals.
Nina (Security): We need to check data residency clauses — QB says EU-only processing for some tenants. Also SOC2 and encryption-at-rest confirmation.
Chris L: Legal asked for indemnity language if they route customer data; will confirm what we can accept.
Omar S: For pricing, rough sketch: baseline host cost + 25% channel uplift for managed network & peering. Need expected RPS, seq lengths, and batch sizes. Can someone ping QB for traffic profile?
Julia G: I asked their eng: they said 150 qps peak, mostly short chats (avg 60 tokens), occasional embeddings batch of 40k vectors.
Kai P: 150 qps with short sequences → we should suggest auto-burst to avoid throttles. Also propose a rate-limit policy: 10 rps per customer tenant with burst to 30 rps, and a shared token-bucket for the channel.
Kai P: Quick k8s snippet for namespace quotas we can apply:```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ResourceQuota
metadata:
  name: qb-channel-quota
  namespace: quantumbridge-<env>
spec:
  hard:
    requests.cpu: "2000m"
    requests.memory: "32Gi"
    limits.cpu: "4000m"
    limits.memory: "64Gi"
    persistentvolumeclaims: "10"
```
Nina (Security): That looks fine. Add encryption keys reference + KMS policy note. Also we require access logs forwarded to SIEM for the joint-POC duration.
Julia G: QB asks about VPC peering latency SLO — can we promise <50ms east-us to their us-east?
Kai P: We can aim for that, but need to validate routing. Recommend we run a short perf probe after peering. If latency >50ms, we fallback to hosted edge region.
Omar S: Pricing note: I'll model two options — (A) flat reserved capacity for 2 weeks, (B) usage-based with burst premiums. Will share numbers by EOD.
Chris L: I'll review the indemnity lines. If QB insists on unlimited liability we won't sign — flagging early.
deploy-bot: cloud-account "qb-channel-staging" created (acct-id: qb-stg-523).
Julia G: Next steps: @Kai to draft runbook (namespaces, quotas, peering checklist, probes), @Nina to confirm logs/KMS wording, @Omar to send pricing options, @Chris to check legal. I'll coordinate with QB to confirm traffic profile and EU processing requirements.
Omar S: Got it, I'll also add a short note about expected egress costs and sample billing calc.
Kai P: I'll drop the runbook link when ready — planning a dry-run Friday.
Nina (Security): If anyone needs the security QS answers early, I can start filling section 1 (infra) and section 4 (encryption).
Julia G: Perfect — thanks all. Tagging this thread when runbook is ready so partner onboarding team can pick up. :thumbsup:
